title: I’m looking for any similarities in people who have these dreams… I’m thinking we might figure some things out if everyone could post a list of like your 3-5 favorite or most impactful books, movies, and songs. I have a feeling some patterns may emerge this way.

classification.question_topic: Requesting participants to share favorite/impactful books, movies, songs, and notable out-of-the-ordinary life experiences to look for similarities among people who have Mall World dreams.
classification.skip_reason: No dream narrative or phenomenological description of a dream/place; post is a data-collection prompt about media preferences and life experiences.

meta.author_theory: Suggests that patterns/similarities among Mall World dreamers might emerge by comparing favorite/impactful books, movies, songs, and unusual/intense life experiences.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains no described dream scenes, locations, entities, or events—only a prompt for respondents to share media preferences and notable life experiences.
